entities.name: Query CTP synthase
observations: 582 aa bacterial enzyme sequence; predicted molecular mass 64.0 kDa and pI 5.84.

Has 64.0–64.5% identity and approximately 92% query coverage to reviewed Geobacteraceae CTP synthases.

entities.name: B9M9Q5 CTP synthase
observations: Reviewed Geotalea daltonii CTP synthase; EC 6.3.4.2.

Also annotated with glutaminase activity and de novo CTP biosynthesis.

entities.name: CTP synthesis from UTP and glutamine
observations: UTP + L-glutamine + ATP + H2O → CTP + L-glutamate + ADP + phosphate + 2 H+; Rhea RHEA:26426; EC 6.3.4.2.

entities.name: CTP synthesis from UTP and ammonia
observations: UTP + NH4+ + ATP → CTP + ADP + phosphate + 2 H+; Rhea RHEA:16597; represents the ammonia-dependent alternative.
The enzyme can generate ammonia internally by hydrolyzing glutamine in the glutaminase domain.

entities.name: Glutamine hydrolysis
observations: L-glutamine + H2O → L-glutamate + NH4+; Rhea RHEA:15889; glutaminase half-reaction associated with CTP synthase.
